clients.title: Client control
clients.intro: Decide which apps and devices may use this Jelee server. Changes take effect on the next request.

policy.title: Unknown clients
policy.hint: Applies to authenticated requests from clients that are not trusted and that no allow rule covers. Sign-in is never blocked, so new clients still appear under Known clients.
policy.exemptAdminsHint: Administrator sessions are never refused; their hits are still recorded.
policy.exemptLoopbackHint: Requests from this machine without forwarding headers are never refused.
policy.confirmPrompt: Takes effect on the next request: {impact}
policy.adminWarning: Administrators are not exempt, so this can lock you out as well.
policy.recovery: If a wrong policy locks everyone out, run {command} on the server to restore the defaults.

unknownImpact.read_only: unknown clients can browse but every change they attempt is refused.
unknownImpact.deny: every request from an unknown client is refused until you trust it or add an allow rule.
unknownImpact.pending_approval: unknown clients wait until an administrator marks them as trusted.

rules.title: Rules
rules.hint: Create a rule in observe mode first and review its hits, then start blocking. Larger priority wins.
rules.enforcePrompt: This rule has {count} hits while observing. Once blocking starts, matching requests get “{action}” immediately. Evaluate the impact in observe mode first.
rules.deletePrompt: This cannot be undone. Its hit records are kept.

ruleForm.scopeGlobal: The rule applies to every user at all times.
ruleForm.scopeKept: This rule's user scope or time window cannot be edited here and is kept as it is.
ruleForm.dimensionHint: Only the IP address and API key fingerprint cannot be forged by the client.
ruleForm.matchHint: CIDR works only with the IP address; “missing” matches when the value is absent.
ruleForm.actionHint: Observe records hits in the statistics; shadow records them only in the hit log. Neither blocks anything.
ruleForm.priorityHint: Larger wins; within one priority a deny beats an allow.
ruleForm.integer: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
ruleForm.invalid: The server cannot use this rule. Check the pattern (regular expression or CIDR) and the combination of fields.
ruleForm.limit: The rule limit has been reached (10,000 rules or 1,000 enabled regular expressions).

known.title: Known clients
known.hint: Clients seen on signed-in requests, most recent first. Trusted clients are not subject to the unknown-client policy.
known.aliasHint: Leave empty to use the name the client reports.
known.kickPrompt: Revokes every active session of {name}. It can sign in again unless it is blocked.
known.blockPrompt: Adds a deny rule with priority 100000 for the device ID of {name} (or its user agent when it reports no device ID). Existing sessions are not signed out.

hits.exportHint: Exports at most 10,000 masked records for the selected mode; larger exports are refused.
